name: Lieke de Vries
bio:
Lieke de Vries is a data analyst with Ipiranga Racing, bringing a potent mix of technical skill and innovative thinking to the team. From a young age, Lieke was captivated by the precision and strategy of Formula 1, spending countless hours analyzing race data and driver performance. This early passion led her to pursue a degree in data science, where she honed her skills in statistical modeling and predictive analytics.

Before joining Ipiranga, Lieke worked as a data consultant, helping businesses optimize their processes through data-driven insights. However, her heart remained in motorsport. At Ipiranga, she focuses on translating raw racing data into actionable strategies, identifying areas for improvement in car setup, driver performance, and race strategy. She's known for her ability to uncover hidden patterns and insights that others often miss, giving the team a competitive edge on the track. Her detail-oriented approach and ambitious drive make her an invaluable asset.

Lieke's distinctive approach lies in her ability to visualize complex data sets in intuitive ways, allowing engineers and strategists to quickly grasp key trends and make informed decisions. She is constantly experimenting with new analytical techniques and tools, always seeking to push the boundaries of what is possible with data in motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Lieke has a focused expression and a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music while analyzing data.
